exclusions.source_text: AST/ALT ≤3×ULN (≤5×ULN if liver metastases); bilirubin ≤1.5×ULN (≤3×ULN if Gilbert's)
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤3×ULN (≤5×ULN if liver metastases); bilirubin ≤1.5×ULN (≤3×ULN if Gilbert's)

exclusions.source_text: Second malignancy within 3 years, except certain skin or cervical cancers.
Significant cardiovascular disease (NYHA Class 3-4 CHF, recent MI, unstable angina, TIA/stroke, or major cardiac procedures within 6 months).
exclusions.threshold: NYHA Class 3-4 CHF; recent MI; major cardiac procedures within 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Active or uncontrolled HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection, or immunodeficiency (controlled infection allowed).
Active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis (previously treated brain metastases allowed if stable).
Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) and men must use effective contraception during the study and for a defined period after treatment.
